question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹4,000 at 6.75% per annum rate of interest deposited on 23 February 2024 and withdrawn on 24 April 2024.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Year 2024 is a leap year, so total days from 23 Feb to 24 Apr = 6 (Feb) + 31 (Mar) + 24 (Apr) = 61 days.

Time (T) in years = 61 ÷ 366 = 1/6 year.

Direct formula: SI = P × R × T ÷ 100

SI = 4000 × 6.75 × (1/6) ÷ 100 = 40 × 1.125 = 45.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹45.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹4,000

Rate (R) = 6.75% per annum

Date of deposit = 23 February 2024

Date of withdrawal = 24 April 2024

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 
• 
 
 
 
 23 Feb 2024
 24 Apr 2024
 
 

 Time (T) = 61 Days
 
 
 P = ₹4000
 
 
 R = 6.75%

 
 SI = ₹45

**Calculations:**

⇒ Year 2024 is divisible by 4, hence it is a leap year and February has 29 days.

⇒ Number of days in February (excluding deposit date) = 29 − 23 = 6 days

⇒ Number of days in March = 31 days

⇒ Number of days in April = 24 days

⇒ Total time (T) in days = 6 + 31 + 24 = 61 days

⇒ Since it is a leap year, total days in the year = 366 days

⇒ Time (T) in years = 61 ÷ 366 = 1/6 year

⇒ SI = (4000 × 6.75 × (1/6)) ÷ 100

⇒ SI = 40 × 6.75 × (1/6)

⇒ SI = 270 ÷ 6

⇒ SI = 45

**∴ The correct answer is ₹45.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest (SI)

It is calculated only on the original principal amount. The formula is SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Calculation of Days

Usually, the day of deposit is excluded and the day of withdrawal is included while calculating the total time period in days.

Leap Year Rule

A year is a leap year if it is exactly divisible by 4 (and by 400 if it is a century year). February has 29 days, making the total year 366 days.
